Installs.Fetches:
set -eu
u=$(id -un)
H='# >>> station:desktop-session >>>'
E='# <<< station:desktop-session <<<'
block=$(printf '%s\n' "$H" 'export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:99}"' 'export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="${DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS:-unix:path=/run/user/$UID/bus}"' "$E")
st=${XDG_STATE_HOME:-}
case $st in /*) ;; *) st=$HOME/.local/state ;; esac
st=$st/station/desktop-session
home=$(readlink -f -- "$HOME")
tmp=
trap '[ -z "$tmp" ] || rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
rcfile() {
  f=$HOME/$1
  if [ -L "$f" ]; then
    t=$(readlink -f -- "$f") || return 1
    case $t in "$home"/*) [ -f "$t" ] && printf '%s\n' "$t" ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$f"
  fi
}
for rc in .zshenv .bashrc; do
  if ! rcfile "$rc" > /dev/null; then
    echo "~/$rc is a link to $(readlink -- "$HOME/$rc"), not to a file of your home, and Machines writes no block through it: make ~/$rc a file, or point it at a file of your home." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  t=$(rcfile "$rc")
  if [ -e "$t" ] && grep -qxF "$H" "$t" && ! grep -qxF "$E" "$t"; then
    echo "$t holds the start line of the desktop-session block and not its end: remove that line and run again." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
mkdir -p "$st"
if [ ! -e "$st/linger" ]; then
  if [ -e "/var/lib/systemd/linger/$u" ]; then echo yours > "$st/linger"; else echo ours > "$st/linger"; fi
fi
sudo -n loginctl enable-linger "$u"
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u)
i=0
until [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/systemd/private" ]; do
  i=$((i+1))
  [ "$i" -le 100 ] || { echo "the user manager of $u did not start" >&2; exit 1; }
  sleep 0.1
done
units=$HOME/.config/systemd/user
mkdir -p "$units" "$HOME/.config/environment.d"
changed=
put() {
  tmp=$(mktemp "${1%/*}/.station-desktop-session.XXXXXX")
  cat > "$tmp"
  if cmp -s "$tmp" "$1"; then
    rm -f "$tmp"
  else
    chmod 0644 "$tmp"
    mv -f "$tmp" "$1"
    changed="$changed ${1##*/}"
  fi
  tmp=
}
put "$units/station-xvfb.service" <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Xvfb, the virtual screen :99 of the desktop session
Wants=station-matchbox.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=30
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1280x800x24
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
UNIT
put "$units/station-matchbox.service" <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=matchbox, the window manager of the desktop session
BindsTo=station-xvfb.service
After=station-xvfb.service

[Service]
Environment=DISPLAY=:99
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/timeout 10 /bin/sh -c 'until [ -S /tmp/.X11-unix/X99 ]; do sleep 0.1; done'
ExecStart=/usr/bin/matchbox-window-manager
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
UNIT
unitschanged=$changed
put "$HOME/.config/environment.d/60-station-desktop-session.conf" <<< DISPLAY=:99
[ -z "$changed" ] || systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable station-xvfb.service station-matchbox.service
verb=start
[ -z "$unitschanged" ] || verb=restart
systemctl --user reset-failed station-xvfb.service station-matchbox.service 2> /dev/null || true
if ! systemctl --user "$verb" station-xvfb.service station-matchbox.service; then
  echo "the virtual screen :99 did not start: another X server may hold :99 (journalctl --user -u station-xvfb)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
for rc in .zshenv .bashrc; do
  t=$(rcfile "$rc")
  if [ ! -e "$t" ]; then
    : > "$t"
    grep -qxF "$rc" "$st/made" 2>/dev/null || echo "$rc" >> "$st/made"
  fi
  if grep -qxF "$H" "$t"; then
    [ "$(sed -n "/^$H\$/,/^$E\$/p" "$t")" != "$block" ] || continue
    tmp=$(mktemp "${t%/*}/.station-desktop-session.XXXXXX")
    BLOCK=$block awk -v h="$H" -v e="$E" '$0==h{print ENVIRON["BLOCK"];s=1;next} s{if($0==e)s=0;next} 1' "$t" > "$tmp"
  else
    tmp=$(mktemp "${t%/*}/.station-desktop-session.XXXXXX")
    { printf '%s\n' "$block"; cat "$t"; } > "$tmp"
  fi
  chmod --reference="$t" "$tmp"
  chown --reference="$t" "$tmp"
  mv -f "$tmp" "$t"
  tmp=
done
